name: YMCA Camp Sherwin Family Campground & Outdoor Center
note: YMCA of Greater Erie camp on the Lake Erie bluff (stairs down to the beach), open to the public; mostly seasonal: about 57 of its ~85 RV sites are seasonal on the 2026 camp map, alongside cabins, a pool and day-pass guests. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator pages + 2026 rate sheet + 2026 camp map (ymcaerie.org, read 2026-10-21: 'open to the public for tent, RV, cabin' camping, nightly rates for W/E, concrete-pad W/E, full-hookup and lake-view pull-through sites, season Apr 15-Oct 31; map legend shows ~28 nightly RV sites rated up to 25-50 ft vs ~57 grey 'Seasonal Sites (Unavailable)', seasonal list is a separate interest form) + CampLife engine 1166 (read 2026-10-21) selling single weeknights with no application on 32 RV sites (F2-F12, RV01, RV17-29, RV35-38 concrete; e.g. RV24 25 ft, RV17 30 ft, F2 50 ft); Google 4.2 (366 reviews); Esri imagery shows the loop of trailer pads around the camp field -> real transient RV campground beside a seasonal section, not a youth-only camp; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21 audit: Esri imagery (sat.py 440 m frame at 42.0470,-80.2995 and satz z18 at 42.04735,-80.29962, both rendered) shows the camp on top of the Lake Erie bluff with a continuous 30-60 m band of bluff-face forest between the loop road/RV rows and the beach; no RV pad visible at the bluff edge or with an open sightline, and the beach is reached only by the operator's 'stairway access to beach from the bluff' (a bluff is a real buffer, so no on-water value). The operator sells two 'Lake View Full Hook Up Pull Through' sites (CampLife F11/F12: 'set on the bluff of Lake Erie') that are absent from the July 2026 map and not identifiable on the imagery, so a lakeview call is unconfirmed -> default down to not waterfront.
fees_source: https://reclique-core-erie.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/23084136/RATE-SHEET-2026-Updated.pdf (read 2026-10-21; family rate for 5 people): summer (Memorial Day-Labor Day) daily RV water+electric $50, concrete-pad W/E $55, full hookup $65, lake-view full-hookup pull-through $80; spring/fall daily $40/$50/$55/$75; weekly = 6 nights. CampLife 1166 estimates read 2026-10-21 for Tue 2026-10-27: RV17/RV24/RV28/RV01 (W/E) $47 for 1 night, $87 for 2 -> $40/night + a $7 unlabeled charge once per stay; F2 $62/$117 ($55 + $7); F11/F12 lake-view $82 ($75 + $7). Summer 2027 dates return no estimate yet.

booking.note: Holiday reservations require a three-night minimum (operator general-info page and rate sheet). For summer 2026, full-hookup sites (and cabins) were booked only as 5-night Friday-Wednesday stays until April, when shorter stays opened; water/electric sites were not under that rule.

flags: YMCA camp (youth summer camp programs on site too), but camping is sold to the public by the night through CampLife with no membership; ownership private (nonprofit).

Nightly share from the July 2026 map legend: ~28 nightly RV sites vs ~57 seasonal (~1 in 3), consistent with CampLife's 32 bookable RV sites (incl. F11/F12 added after the map). Seasonal sites go via an interest form/waitlist, nightly sites need none.

Booking-window rule: summer 2026 full-hookup sites sold only as 5-night Fri-Wed stays until April 2026, then shorter stays opened (AWH 2026-10-19: avoidable long minimum, recorded not dropped). W/E sites ($50 summer) were not covered.
$7 per-stay charge folded into CampLife's subtotal (1 vs 2 night quotes); not per night, so not added to the rate.
Lake-view F11/F12 ('on the bluff of Lake Erie') are a re-audit lead for lakeview once imagery or a site photo shows them; left not waterfront by default-down.
Some sites are short: RV23 is rated up to 20 ft and RV22-26 up to 25 ft; plenty fit 23 ft (RV17 30 ft, F sites 45-50 ft).
